description: Validate and look up a phone number. Returns validity, formatted number, line type (mobile/landline/voip), carrier info, and location. Uses Twilio Lookup API.

countryCode.description: Country dialing code without + (e.g. "1" for US, "44" for UK). Defaults to "44".

phone.description: Phone number to verify (any format, E.164 preferred)

name: verify_phone
